subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

All criminal tendencies must be __nipped on the bud__ during childhood.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. nipped in the bud .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**nipped in the bud**" is an idiom that means to stop something at an early stage before it has a chance to develop.
 
• Options 1 ("nipped off the bud") and 2 ("nipped at the bud") are incorrect because they do not convey the same idiomatic meaning.
 
• Option 3 ("No substitution required") is incorrect because the original phrase "nipped on the bud" is not the correct idiom.

Correct sentence: *All criminal tendencies must be **nipped in the bud** during childhood*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Idioms:**
 
 
• Idioms are phrases or expressions that have a figurative meaning different from the literal meaning of the words used.
 
• Example: "**Spill the beans**" means to reveal a secret.
 
 
 
• **Commonly Confused Phrases:**
 
 
• Using correct idioms is important for clear and effective communication.
 
• Example: "**Piece of cake**" means something very easy.
